description: Payments confirmed by the business server: payments.confirm and the gateway helpers (SPEC 22; backend C11 B2.2, B2.3)

cases.description: Every B2.2 field maps to the wire; the confirmation object is returned
pending and failed may omit amount and currency; unset options are omitted
amount_minor is sent as an integer instead of amount
A native decimal amount keeps its scale (SPEC 8)
An integer amount is sent as its digits, in a string
A native datetime is sent as RFC 3339 UTC
A repeat answers 200 with duplicate true: success, not an error
A 503 is retried with the same Idempotency-Key and body
A caller-supplied Idempotency-Key is used as given
A 422 from the API is an InvalidRequestError with its code and param, not retried
